lines: Logical female Kuva Lich voice lines.
These voice lines are affected by the weapon's element used to kill the Larvling.
- "Your dismemberment of me has not resulted in a conventional outcome."
- "Arms. Legs. Organs. There is nothing you can take from that I cannot replace. No Hell you can consign me to from which the blood of the Queens cannot retrieve me."
- "The dismemberment you subjected me to was not my first. Will not be my last. Death is no solution to the problem of me."
- "I have been bisected, dissected, autopsied, upgraded... the line between who I was and what I am erased and redrawn more times than I have bothered to record."
- "Your murder of me is now redefined as your attempted murder of me."
- "I am of the old blood. We do not die, foolish Adversary."
- "I am no stranger to the lands beyond Death. It is a sunless place, in a direction you cannot point to. Soon... you shall reside there."
- "My primate ancestors attempted to fell the moon by hurling stones at it. Your attempts to fell me are no different. You have been... out-evolved, Adversary."
- "You incinerated me once, but you'll learn this: the only fire in which we burn, is time. And the blood of the Queens? Has rendered me... fire-proof."
- "Fire. Building a revenge is like building a fire. You wait, work, accumulate, and then, at the right moment, TOSS THE MATCH!"
- "They say freezing to death is like going to sleep. No, it was an awakening."
- "Since you froze me, I feel nothing. Numb. I do not feel the world. I do not feel. I am naught but my will. I will you... ill."
- "With your freezing touch my blood pressure dropped to zero. My mind is clear. My thoughts... crystalline."
- "With cold come silence. In silence, with cognitive processors supercooled, I can think. Plan. Execute."
- "Your voltage exceeded survivable tolerances. And yet, I live."
- "In a flash your current rewrote who I am. Optimized me. Focused me. On you."
- "I may be electric, but I'm anything but static."
- "You thought you put me down. Instead, I was supercharged."
- "Your poison did not kill, I evolved. You are no poisoner. You lie. You are a lie."
- "If a poison does not poison it is not a poison. If a killer does not kill they are not a killer. Conclusion: You are not very good at your job."
- "With the addition of your toxin, my body has become a laboratory. In it I develop new miracles. I open gateways... to death."
- "I am pregnant with your poison! Our child is death."
- "I can wait forever, Adversary. But I won't."
- "Your crime has not been forgotten, Adversary. Your crime of existence."
- "Your reactions fall within expected parameters. Outcomes have been mapped. Continue as you are. I shall be waiting."
- "You can no more resolve a solution for the equation I represent than a kubrow might fathom a card trick."
- "Think, Adversary. Fathom me. Find me. And die."
- Dialogue is randomly pulled from #Birth of Kuva Lich, #After Logging In, #Spawning, and #Taunts sections.

path: Navigating controlled sectors in the Star Chart
lines: - "The Sector is under control. Resistance crushed. Troops: begin optimizing the local workforce."
- "Witness: my control expands to a new sector. Accept: you lack the capacity to stop me. Resolve: to surrender or die. We shall speak again."
- "Dictating terms to relevant personages in mining, personnel and security. This Sector has a new master."

path: Completing a Mission on an affected Node
lines: - "All who pass through my Sector must pay the tax. You are no exception, my little Adversary."
- "Adversary: I have taken my tithe, as is my right as holder of this Sector."
- "I take your coin as easily as I take your life, your power, your joy."

path: After Revealing a Requiem Mod / Upgrade Rank of the Kuva Lich
lines: - "You apply what you have learned and draw a successful conclusion. Outcome: we are now in closer proximity."
- "You draw closer to me, according to the timetable I have set."
- "You draw closer. I pity you, this false moment of triumph before, head-high, you stride into the threshing jaws of what I truly am."
- "Your arrival is noted. Your expulsion inevitable. Proceed."
- "Encounter: modeled. There are three solutions in which you win, 439 in which you die. Your move."
- "You shall die, and I shall allow myself... enjoyment."
- "I see you, Adversary, and I adapt."
- "You fight one gifted the old blood - the Queen's kuva. Death will not end me."

path: One Health Bar Left / After Attacking with Correct Requiem Mod
lines: - "I have not... planned... for this... contingency."
- "The more you resist, the stronger I grow. The greater the adversity, the faster I evolve."
- "I grow... I evolve. What wonders the old blood has revealed to me."
- "I evolve, to what heights might I reach! The stars themselves graze against my straining fingertips. Thank you Queens for the gift of your blood."
- "There is... nothing... left... within myself... to... conquer. I. AM. OPTIMIZED."
- "I am whole, complete, final. I am, at last, the warrior the Queens intended for me to be. I AM! THE OLD BLOOD!"
- "Very well. I am terminating this engagement. We shall meet again."
- "Facinating. I shall factor this experience into future engagement models. Farewell."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "Your strategy is unsound: a byproduct of emotional motivations and reactive thinking. It shall be your undoing."

path: Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "I have learned a great deal since last we met. You shall regret pursuing me."

Taking down the Kuva Lich in Railjack
lines: - "You have made a tactical error in coming here, Adversary."
- "The supposed hunter arrives, nostrils flared, chest full of hubris. Very well. We have time for one quick lesson."
- "Allegiance or death? Nothing is gained from death. And so: allegiance."
- "Very well. I concede. We are allied."
- "Very well, Adversary. You have my sword. Forgive me, my Queens."

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "Are you trying to get yourself killed? Allow me to assist."
- "My assistance will increase your probability of success considerably."

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "Victory criteria have been successfully met. Exfiltrating."
- "Efficient and effective. I take my leave."
- "My obligations here are concluded. By your leave."

path: When Converted Kuva Lich Assists the Player
lines: - "I am overwhelmed! Learn from my failure!"
- "My defeat has bought you time. Exploit it!"
- "The enemy has removed me from this equation. Adjust and conquer!"
- "'Nature'. A festering cesspit of allergens... and... IRRITANTS!"
- "'Nature'. Variables detail, variables movement, variables odors, colors, barometric fluctuations, atmospheric agitation. Variables!"
- "I may not see you, but I smell you."
- "I have... overestimated my capabilities. Withdrawing. Withdrawing!"
- "Adversary more competent than modeled. Withdrawing to restrategize."
- "If... if you could defeat an Eximus, I must fallback... to rethink."
- "Reaccessing. Adversary more formidable than anticipated. Query: have you been working out? Strategy: retreat."
- "Outnumbered! Engagement is tactically unsound. Rethinking strategy!"
- "Allies all gone. Odds of success falling. Help! I need help!"
- "Children? Children! Unevolved, undeveloped, single-function, parasitic lifeforms! Too human. Too human, away!"
- "Human... human children? From a human mother? No! Too much! I can't bear it! AWAY! AWAY!"
- "Vision spinning. Breath short. Altitude... I have to get away. Away. AWAY!"
- "No. Too close, too close to the edge. No more. NO MORE!"
- "Space! Infinite... space! Should never have come here!"
- "Space! Ghosts of space, incalculable void. My mind a recursive plummeting loop."
- "Come and get it, you little brat!"
- "Children. Your lack of evolution offends me! Your presence here will not be tolerated!"
- "Corpus targets. Negative. Adversary is priority. Kill Corpus! Negativ–KILL CORPUS!"
- "Infested filth! I consign you to the Void!"
- "Reinforcements are superfluous to needs. The strategy coalesces. I am focused."
- "Alone, at last. Just you and me."
- "Every Grineer traitor has a tell. And when I see that tell... it's lights out."
- "Witness the universe in a tongue of flame. As it licks the very flesh from your snotty, little bones."
- "A moment, Adversary. I have spotted a prime specimen I simply must have for my wall."
- "Prestine fauna specimen. Collection will take but a moment. Reprioritizing target."
- "Visual feedback confirms a platonic ideal of perfection/imperfection. I am pretty."
